clips.title: The story
paras: Rahauro sends you from Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise into Ragefire Chasm. Magatha Grimtotem seeks her lost emissary Maur and the unusual discovery he made among the troggs.

Magatha Grimtotem hears on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise that her emissary, Maur Grimtotem, entered the cavern beneath Orgrimmar to study the troggs and try to parley with them. He never returned, and rumors say he found something unusual shortly before his death. While Warchief Thrall and his advisers focus on the Shadow Council presence in Ragefire Chasm, the Grimtotem clan follows its own interests.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.
Return to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.
Again, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The body looks seriously beaten by clubs or fists, but most of the corpse's clothing and equipment still looks present. It seems the troggs do not overly care much for material wealth.
You begin to search the body for anything of interest that might help Magatha.
